# User Stories — Rock Paper Scissors

## Core Gameplay

- As a player, I want to choose between Rock, Paper, and Scissors, so that I can play the game against the computer.

- As a player, I want the computer to randomly select Rock, Paper, or Scissors, so that each round provides an unpredictable challenge.

- As a player, I want the game to determine whether I win, lose, or draw each round, so that I clearly understand the outcome.

- As a player, I want the game to explain why I won or lost, so that I understand which choice beats the other.

- As a player, I want the first player to reach five points to win the match, so that every match has a clear finishing point.

- As a player, I want to see my score and the computer's score updated after every round, so that I can keep track of the match.

## AI Opponent

- As a player, I want to play against a computer opponent, so that I can play the game without needing another person.

- As a player, I want the computer to make its choice automatically after I choose my move, so that the game flows smoothly.

- As a player, I want the computer's choice displayed after each round, so that I can see what move it made.

- As a player, I want the computer's choices to be randomly generated, so that I cannot easily predict its next move.

## Game Results

- As a player, I want to see my selected choice after each round, so that I can confirm what I played.

- As a player, I want to see the computer's selected choice, so that I can compare both moves.

- As a player, I want clear win, lose, and draw messages, so that I immediately understand the round result.

- As a player, I want a clear match-winning message when I reach five points, so that I know when I have won the game.

- As a player, I want the final score to remain visible when the match ends, so that I can see how the match finished.

## Game Controls

- As a player, I want clearly labelled Rock, Paper, and Scissors buttons, so that I can easily select my move.

- As a player, I want the game buttons to respond immediately when clicked, so that I can play without unnecessary delays.

- As a player, I want the game controls to be disabled when the match ends, so that I cannot accidentally start another round.

- As a player, I want a Reset Game button, so that I can start a new match whenever I want.

- As a player, I want the Reset button to restore the game to its initial state, so that I can begin a fresh match.

## Timing and Pacing

- As a player, I want each round to begin immediately after selecting my move, so that the game maintains a smooth pace.

- As a player, I want the game to avoid unnecessary delays between rounds, so that I can continue playing easily.

- As a player, I want to play the game at my own pace, so that I do not feel rushed while choosing my move.

## Personalization

- As a player, I want to enter my name, so that the game feels more personal.

- As a player, I want to switch between light and dark themes, so that I can choose a comfortable appearance.

- As a player, I want to toggle sound effects on or off, so that I can play the game with or without audio.

- As a player sensitive to motion, I want an option to reduce animations, so that I can play comfortably.

## Progress and Statistics

- As a returning player, I want my game statistics saved, so that I can track my performance over time.

- As a player, I want to see the total number of rounds I have played, so that I can measure my activity.

- As a player, I want to see how many rounds I have won, lost, and drawn, so that I can understand my performance.

- As a player, I want to see my win percentage, so that I can measure how successful I am.

- As a player, I want to see my best winning streak, so that I have a personal record to improve.

- As a player, I want to see my most frequently selected throw, so that I can learn about my playing habits.

## Persistence

- As a returning player, I want my statistics stored in the browser, so that they are not lost when I refresh the page.

- As a returning player, I want my saved statistics to load automatically, so that I can continue tracking my progress without entering the information again.

- As a player, I want to clear my saved statistics, so that I can start tracking my progress from zero.

## Accessibility

- As a keyboard-only player, I want to navigate and select every game control using my keyboard, so that I can play without a mouse.

- As a keyboard-only player, I want clear focus indicators on interactive controls, so that I always know which control is selected.

- As a screen reader user, I want round results announced automatically, so that I can follow the game without relying on visual information.

- As a screen reader user, I want the player and computer choices announced, so that I can understand what happened during each round.

- As a player with visual difficulties, I want sufficient colour contrast between text and backgrounds, so that the game remains easy to read.

- As a player on a mobile device, I want buttons to be large enough to tap easily, so that I can play without accidentally selecting the wrong move.

## Responsive Design

- As a first-time visitor, I want the game to work across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices, so that I can play regardless of which device I use.

- As a mobile player, I want the game controls to fit comfortably on a small screen, so that I do not need to zoom or scroll horizontally.

- As a player, I want the layout to remain consistent across different screen sizes, so that the game is easy to understand on any device.

- As a player, I want the scoreboard, controls, and results to remain visible and readable on smaller screens, so that I can follow the game easily.

## Visual Design and Feedback

- As a player, I want the Rock, Paper, and Scissors buttons to have distinct visual styles, so that I can identify them quickly.

- As a player, I want buttons to provide hover and focus feedback, so that I know when they are interactive.

- As a player, I want winning, losing, and draw results to have different visual feedback, so that I can recognise the outcome quickly.

- As a player, I want smooth visual transitions when interacting with the game, so that the interface feels polished and responsive.

## Optional Features

- As a player, I want sound effects when making a choice or winning a round, so that the game feels more engaging.

- As a player, I want animations when a round or match ends, so that the game feels more interactive.

- As a player, I want to choose different difficulty levels, so that I can adjust the challenge to my skill level.

- As a player, I want the game to remember my preferred theme and settings, so that I do not have to configure them every time I return.

- As a player, I want to unlock achievements for accomplishments, so that I have additional goals beyond winning individual matches.

## Testing

- As a developer, I want to test every possible Rock, Paper, and Scissors combination, so that the game always produces the correct result.

- As a developer, I want to test the scoring system, so that points are only awarded to the correct player.

- As a developer, I want to test the first-to-five system, so that the match ends at the correct time.

- As a developer, I want to test the Reset Game functionality, so that a new match always starts correctly.

- As a developer, I want to test the game on different screen sizes, so that the responsive layout works correctly.

- As a developer, I want to test keyboard and screen-reader accessibility, so that the game can be used by as many players as possible.

- As a developer, I want to test optional features independently, so that they do not interfere with the core gameplay.
